review.summary: Settlement is safe for the authorized paused, zero-USDT BOT Chain 677 create: chain/token allowlists, 6-decimal check, SafeERC20, payout-id replay guard, and constructor pause on 677/968 all hold, while 31337/43113 stay unpaused and src/chain.ts plus config.ts still reject BOT runtime. Compile immutable patching matches ganache-deployed runtime (one immutable id, three 32-byte slots). The send path still has two nonce-0 operational defects: spot gasPrice is frozen into a non-replaceable journaled legacy tx, and the CLI catch hides the failure that tells an operator whether to retry send or stop.

findings.title: Nonce-0 gasPrice is spot-quoted and cannot be replaced after the journal
findings.body: prepare stores `getGasPrice()` with only a 20% gas-limit buffer, then send signs that exact `gas`/`gasPrice` into a write-ahead legacy creation tx and forbids a second nonce-0 signature. eth_call/estimateGas do not prove mempool inclusion. If base fee rises after prepare, the pinned tx can sit unmined while nonce 0 and address `getContractAddress(OWNER, 0)` stay reserved; bumping fees would require a different signed payload, which this script correctly refuses. The 0.02 BOT cap is an upper bound, not the bid, so unused headroom is left on the table. This is not a contract-funds bug (deploy is unfunded), but it can stall the only authorized creation.
findings.recommendation: Before the first `signTransaction`, re-quote `getGasPrice()` and set `gasPrice` to the min of a buffered quote and `MAX_FEE / gas`, then persist that price in the plan and the journaled tx. If a journal already exists, do not sign a replacement; only rebroadcast the stored raw tx.

findings.title: CLI catch discards the error that distinguishes journal poison from a precondition miss
findings.body: `main(...).catch(() => { console.error('Deployment stopped: ... Preserve .local/botchain-deploy; never create a new nonce.'); })` swallows the assertion. Operators then cannot see `Broadcast uncertain; preserve journal`, `Owner nonce changed`, `Wrong signer`, or a post-sign parse failure. The generic line is directionally right, but a nonce-0 one-shot deploy fails closed in several different ways; hiding which one happened is how people delete `signed.json` and try to re-sign. Node/Bun will not print the assertion once it is caught.
findings.recommendation: Log the caught `error` (message plus stack) and then print the preserve-journal line. Do not change the fail-closed control flow.

next_steps: Fix the two send-path issues before `send`; if a journal already exists, only rebroadcast that raw tx and do not rotate nonce 0.
Keep `.local/botchain-deploy` on disk; treat `Broadcast uncertain` as do-not-re-sign until `eth_getTransaction` for the journal hash is conclusive.
Optional: add local tests for prepare/send/verify (approved-hash gate, write-ahead journal, nonce/pending checks) without hitting live RPC or loading a private key.
After inclusion, confirm paused==true, USDT balance 0, runtime hash, admin/executor roles; do not fund, unpause, or enable backend payouts.

resolution.gasQuote: Refresh before first signature, buffer 10 percent, cap total at 0.02 BOT; never replace an existing signed journal.
resolution.diagnostics: Report failure stage and explicit assertion reason; suppress raw RPC bodies and credentials.
resolution.validation: 137 tests pass, typecheck pass; contract bytecode unchanged after review.
resolution.hostVerdict: Resolved for paused unfunded deployment only; not a general production audit.
